lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to Echo Valley! Look at the mountains. Now listen. Hello! Hello... hello... hello! That's an echo. Today we compare two things. Echo Valley is bigger than the plains. Say it with me. Echo Valley is bigger than the plains. Great! Big, bigger. Tall, taller. When we compare two things, we add e, r and say than. 2つを くらべる ときは ～er than だよ。 The mountains are taller than the trees. The river is longer than the road. Let's practice. An elephant is bigger than a dog. A giraffe is taller than a horse. Now you. Look at your pencil and your eraser. My pencil is longer than my eraser. Wonderful! Now, phonics. Taller. Tallest. Longer. Longest. Just add e, r or e, s, t. Tallest means number one. OK, let's shout together. Hello, Echo Valley!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! We're in the forest of Echo Valley. Look at these trees. This tree is very tall. That tree is not so tall. So, this tree is taller than that tree. Say it with me. This tree is taller than that tree. Good! And that tree is shorter than this tree. Tall, taller. Short, shorter. たかいは taller、ひくいは shorter だよ。 Let's practice. Everyone, stand up! Stand on your toes. You are taller now! Crouch down. Now you are shorter. Which tree is taller? This one is. Which tree is shorter? That one is. Now, phonics. Larger. Nicest. Wider. Safest. Large ends with e, so we just add r. Nice ends with e, so we just add s, t. Now look out the window. Find a tall thing. Is it taller than your house? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Listen. Can you hear the water? We're walking along the river. This river is very, very long. It's the longest river in the valley. Say it with me. This is the longest river in the valley. Great! Long, longer, longest. For number one, we say the and add e, s, t. いちばんは the ～est だよ。 Look at this rock. It's the biggest rock in the river. And here, the water is very deep. It's the deepest part. Be careful! Let's practice. Who is the tallest in your family? My dad is the tallest in my family. What is the biggest animal? The blue whale is the biggest animal. Now, phonics. Bigger. Hottest. Thinner. Wettest. Big has a short vowel and one consonant at the end. So we double the g. Big, bigger, biggest. lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Welcome to the Valley Museum. Look up! This is a model of a blue whale. It's huge! Is it heavier than an elephant? Yes! A blue whale is heavier than an elephant. Say it with me. A blue whale is heavier than an elephant. Excellent! Heavy ends with y. So we change y to i and add e, r. Heavy, heavier. y で おわる ことばは y を i に かえて er だよ。 The opposite of heavy is light. A feather is lighter than a rock. Let's practice. Which is heavier, a lion or a bear? A bear is heavier. Which is heavier, a cat or a horse? A horse is heavier. Now, phonics. Happier. Heaviest. Easier. Funniest. Happy, happier. Funny, funniest. Now pick up your pencil case and your book. Which is heavier? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we're making the Valley Record Book. It has amazing animal records. Here is the first card. The cheetah is the fastest land animal. Say it with me. The cheetah is the fastest land animal. Great! Land means not in the water and not in the sky. Here is the next card. The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world. And the blue whale is the biggest animal. Let's read a card together. Name: cheetah. Record: the fastest land animal. It is faster than a horse. きろくカードは the ～est で 発表しよう。 Now, phonics review. Older. Cutest. Hotter. Earliest. Old, just add e, r. Cute, just add s, t. Hot, double the t. Early, change y to i. Now it's your turn. Choose an animal and make a record card. Read it to your friends!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Wow, look at this flower field! There are so many flowers. This flower is pretty. And this flower is very, very pretty. This flower is more beautiful. Say it with me. This flower is more beautiful. Great! Beautiful is a long word. We don't say beautifuller. We say more beautiful. ながい ことばは more を つけるよ。 More beautiful. More exciting. More interesting. Let's practice. Which is more exciting, a game or a book? For me, a game is more exciting. Which is more interesting, a movie or a comic? A comic is more interesting! Which flower is more beautiful? I think this one is. Now, phonics. Long words have one strong part. EL-e-phant. kan-ga-ROO. go-RIL-la. OC-to-pus. Say the strong part big and long. Now, look around you. Which is more beautiful, the sky or the sea? Tell me what you think!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We're at the Valley Zoo. The zoo is asking visitors a question. What is your favorite animal? Look at the results. Ten people chose pandas. Five people chose koalas. Three people chose lions. So, pandas are the most popular. Say it with me. Pandas are the most popular. Wonderful! Popular is a long word. So for number one, we say the most. The most popular. The most beautiful. The most exciting. ながい ことばの いちばんは the most だよ。 Let's practice. What is the most popular sport in your class? Maybe soccer is the most popular. What is the most popular food? Maybe curry and rice! Now, phonics. ba-NA-na. to-MA-to. po-TA-to. PINE-ap-ple. In English, banana is strong in the middle. Now, think about your class. What is the most popular game? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! We're in the valley orchard. Look at all the fruit trees! There are apples, oranges and peaches. Mmm. Which do I like? I like apples better than oranges. Say it with me. I like apples better than oranges. Great! Good, better, best. Good is special. We don't say gooder. We say better and best. good は better、best に かわるよ。 And I like peaches the best. They're sweet and soft. Let's practice. Do you like dogs better than cats? I like dogs better than cats. What fruit do you like the best? I like strawberries the best. Which do you like better, juice or milk? I like juice better. Now, phonics. DI-no-saur. BUT-ter-fly. chim-pan-ZEE. fla-MIN-go. Clap and say the strong part big. OK, your turn. Which do you like better, rice or bread? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we're at the dinosaur dig in Echo Valley. Look! People found a big fossil here. Let's look at the picture. This dinosaur was very big. It was as big as a bus. Say it with me. This dinosaur was as big as a bus. Excellent! As big as means the same size. おなじくらいは as ～ as だよ。 Look at this tooth. Its tooth is as long as a banana! Was it as tall as a giraffe? Almost! Let's practice. My bag is as heavy as a big book. You are as quick as a rabbit! This rock is as round as a ball. Now, phonics. Quickly. Slowly. Quietly. Loudly. Add l, y and we can say how something happens. Walk slowly. Dig quickly. Now, look around. Find two things that are the same size. My pencil is as long as my ruler!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today we're having a race in the valley. Ready, set, go! Look, a horse is running with us. It's so fast! I can't win. I'm not as fast as a horse. Say it with me. I'm not as fast as a horse. Good! Not as fast as means the horse is faster. ～ほど…ない は not as ～ as だよ。 A turtle is not as fast as a rabbit. A mouse is not as big as a cat. But I'm faster than a turtle! Let's practice. Is a cat as big as a lion? No. A cat is not as big as a lion. Is a car as fast as a plane? No. A car is not as fast as a plane. Now, phonics. Softly. Kindly. Safely. Bravely. Safe ends with e, but we keep the e and add l, y. Speak softly. Play safely. Now, compare yourself with an animal. I'm not as strong as a gorilla!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone. Shh. We're in the bird hut. Look out the window. The birds are sleeping in their nests. Walk quietly. The birds are sleeping. Say it softly with me. Walk quietly. The birds are sleeping. Very good! Quiet, quietly. Slow, slowly. Quick, quickly. ly を つけると「どんなふうに」に なるよ。 Open the window slowly. Sit down quickly. Speak softly, please. Let's practice. Show me. Walk slowly. Walk quickly. Now walk quietly. Great! Now talk softly to your friend. Hello, how are you? Good. Now clap your hands quickly. Now clap slowly. Now, phonics. Happily. Easily. Angrily. Luckily. Happy ends with y, so we change y to i and add l, y. Luckily, the birds didn't wake up! Now, how do you eat your breakfast? Quickly or slowly? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone. Listen. Hello! ...hello... Hmm. The echo is very quiet today. The echo sounds unhappy today. Say it with me. The echo sounds unhappy today. Good. Unhappy means not happy. Sounds unhappy means I hear it, and I think it's not happy. きこえる ようすは sounds ～ だよ。 When a friend has a sad face, say, what's wrong? You look sad. Let's practice. Your friend is crying. What's wrong? You look sad. Your friend is smiling. You look cheerful! The music is slow and quiet. It sounds sad. The music is fast and loud. It sounds happy! The echo is weak and quiet. It sounds unhappy. Now, phonics. Colorful. Helpful. Wonderful. Cheerful. Ful means full of something. But f, u, l has only one l. Let's be helpful friends. How can we cheer up the echo? Let's think together!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Look. This is the rope bridge over the valley. It's long, and it moves a little. Be careful! Don't be careless. Say it with me. Be careful! Don't be careless. Great! Careful means you think and you stay safe. Careless means you don't think. careful は「ちゅういぶかい」、careless は「ふちゅういな」だよ。 Here are the bridge rules. Hold the rope with both hands. Don't run on the bridge. Walk slowly. Let's practice. Your friend is running near the pool. Be careful! Don't run! Your friend is carrying hot soup. Be careful! It's hot! Your friend left a bag on the stairs. Don't be careless. Someone may fall! Now, phonics. Careful. Careless. Useful. Useless. Ful means full of. Less means without. Careful, full of care. Careless, without care. Now, when do you need to be careful at home? Tell me!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! We're still at the gift shop. There are two stuffed animals, a bear and a rabbit. Which one do I like better? I like this one better because it's cuter. Say it with me. I like this one better because it's cuter. Wonderful! Because gives the reason. りゆうは because で つなげるよ。 If someone asks why, answer with because. Why do you like that one? Because it's softer. Let's practice. Which cup do you like better? I like the blue cup better because it's bigger. Which bag do you like better? I like the red bag better because it's lighter. Now, phonics. Playful. Peaceful. Thankful. Sleepless. Play plus f, u, l. Sleep plus l, e, s, s. Now, think of two snacks. Which one do you like better? Tell me why!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we're having a mini discussion. The question is, dogs or cats? Which do you like better? Here is my opinion. I like dogs better because they're friendly. Say it with me. I like dogs better because they're friendly. Great! They're means they are. We say they because we mean all dogs. Now listen to Riko's opinion. I like cats better because they're quiet and soft. When you hear a good reason, say, that's a good point. なるほど と おもったら That's a good point. だよ。 You don't need a pet to join the discussion. Let's practice. Which do you like better, rabbits or hamsters? I like rabbits better because they're cute. That's a good point! Now, phonics review. Colorful. Careless. Playful. Harmless. Now it's your turn. Dogs or cats? Tell me your opinion and your reason!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we're visiting the old buildings in the valley. Here is a stone bridge and an old tower. They're both very old. But which is older? Which is older, the bridge or the tower? Say it with me. Which is older, the bridge or the tower? Excellent! To answer, say, The tower is. Or say, The tower is older. どっちか きく ときは Which is ～er, A or B? だよ。 The tower is older. It's three hundred years old. The bridge is two hundred years old. Let's practice. Which is bigger, the sun or the moon? The sun is. Which is longer, a train or a bus? A train is. Now, phonics. Unlock. Untie. Unpack. Unzip. Lock, unlock. Tie, untie. Un can mean opening or undoing. The tower door is locked. Let's unlock it with this old key! Now ask your friend a question. Which is bigger, a cat or a dog?

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, writers! Today you'll write comparison sentences. Let's look at Haru's sentences. My bag is heavier than Riko's bag. Say it with me. My bag is heavier than Riko's bag. Good! Riko's bag means the bag that belongs to Riko. ～の は 's で あらわすよ。 Here's the next one. My pencil is longer than my eraser. And one more. Riko's bag is more colorful, but my bag is bigger. Use but to show two sides. Now, it's your turn. Look at the things on your desk. Write three or four sentences. My book is bigger than my notebook. My eraser is smaller than my pencil case. My bag is heavier than my lunch box. Compare things, not people. That's kind. Now, phonics. Unfriendly. Unhealthy. Unwrap. Unbutton. Friendly, unfriendly. Wrap, unwrap. OK, writers. Read your sentences to a friend!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! The echo spirit is still unhappy. Let's make a plan to cheer it up. Here's my idea. Let's make the biggest echo ever! Say it with me. Let's make the biggest echo ever! Wonderful! Ever means of all time. The biggest echo ever is bigger than all the echoes before. ever は「いままでで」だよ。 How can we make a big echo? Why don't we shout together? Good idea! Our voices will be louder together. What should we shout? Let's shout kind words. Thank you! You're wonderful! Let's practice. Why don't we sing a song? Good idea! Why don't we invite the animals? Good idea! Why don't we clap, too? Good idea! Now, phonics review. Biggest. Louder. Loudly. Happily. OK, everyone. Take a deep breath. Are you ready for the biggest echo ever?

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to the World 18 Comparison Show on the valley stage! The echo spirit is watching, too. Let's start with our big sentence. Echo Valley is the most wonderful place! Say it with me. Echo Valley is the most wonderful place! Fantastic! In this world, we learned so many ways to compare. Taller, the tallest. More beautiful, the most beautiful. Better, best. As big as a bus. Not as fast as a horse. Now, share your opinion with a reason. I like Echo Valley the best because the echo is our friend. ワールド18 の まとめだよ。くらべる ことばで 発表しよう。 Let's do a quick review. A blue whale is heavier than an elephant. The cheetah is the fastest land animal. Phonics review. Wider. Nicest. AN-i-mal. Slowly. Wonderful. Unlock. You did a wonderful job! Now, take a deep breath, stand taller and shout louder. Our echo is bigger than ever!
